boss_admin_user_ids.description: Authorized administrator user IDs. An explicit list takes precedence over platform administrators.

broadcast_delay.description: Delay between battle messages in seconds (0 to 10).

enable_gif.description: Enable GIF battle replays. Requires Chrome or Chromium; unavailable rendering falls back to text.

render_concurrency.description: Maximum simultaneous GIF render workers (1 to 4).

render_timeout.description: GIF rendering timeout in seconds (5 to 300).

avatar_max_mb.description: Maximum avatar download size in MiB (1 to 20).
